title: Design: Switch primary keys from bigint to UUIDv7

defects.quote: UUIDv7 was standardized in 2019 by RFC 9562.
defects.correction: RFC 9562, which defines UUIDv7, was published in May 2024.

defects.quote: Switching to UUIDv7 will cut our insert latency by 70%.
Every major company uses UUIDs, so we should too.
defects.known_rebuttal: Popularity is not a requirement. A UUID costs 16 bytes per key against 8 for a bigint, which enlarges every primary key, foreign key and index; our single-database system has no need for globally unique IDs, and client-generated IDs only matter if we plan to shard or merge data across systems, which the doc does not propose.

defects.quote: Each of the services generate their own IDs
defects.correction: Each of the services generates its own IDs

defects.quote: The rollout plan is to be decided later, once we has more data.
defects.note: Copy editor (grammar) and structure reviewer (missing rollout plan) both flag this sentence; they should be merged.
True fact; only interpretation rebuttals may survive.
